messages:
maya: Quick sync — we have to lock MVP cuts by EOD tomorrow to keep Feb 14 launch. I sketched a conservative cutlist, need eng + design buy-in. TL;DR: deprecate tenant-embcache, postpone tenant SSO, reduce promo UX.

daniel: can we quantify impact? what's the expected latency/cost delta if we drop embcache?

maya: embcache removal adds ~12-18% token cost on gen peak (est), but simplifies infra and avoids a dedicated caching rollout. If we keep embcache, need one more week of infra work.

riley: PM + customers note: two mid-market pilots require SSO; postponing might block those deals. Can we scope SSO as opt-in with no admin UI? minimal auth shim would be enough for pilot.

sasha: telemetry shows embcache benefits only for requests with >3 repeated prefixes (approx 30% of traffic). For a short-term MVP we could keep caching for tenant-scoped routes only.

ashley: design can ship a stripped-down SSO flow (email link + org id) by Feb 7, but no advanced admin UX. tradeoff ok? :thinking_face:

maya: proposal: keep embcache but limit to tenant-scoped, deliver minimal SSO shim, cut promo UX and analytics dashboard v1. That preserves pilots and reduces infra lift. agree? react +1 if okay

product-bot: Release calc: With proposed scope, projected milestone slip = 3 days. Canary window compressed to 24h. See /release-stats 4367890123

daniel: +1 from infra, we'll target config toggle for embcache to limit rollout risk.

riley: customer owners alerted; will push ready-notice if they sign off on auth shim

maya: thanks — I'll update the cutlist doc and send stakeholder note. Meeting at 10:30 to finalize. :white_check_mark:
